title: A Discrete Variable Preprocessing Method for Vertical Federated Learning

pse.problem: The current methods for preprocessing discrete variables in vertical federated learning cause data dimension explosion or overfitting/underfitting issues due to high-cardinality variables.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a Target-Encoding algorithm that encodes high-cardinality discrete variables, reducing memory consumption and improving model performance by minimizing the feature dimensionality increase and addressing underfitting/overfitting issues.
pse.solution_structure: Target-Encoding algorithm modifies the LabelEncoder method to encode high-cardinality discrete features without assuming an order relationship between categories. It generates a sparse matrix where each row represents a sample, columns correspond to unique category values, and each non-zero element indicates the presence of a certain category in the respective sample.
pse.solution_implementation: During training, Target-Encoding applies cross-validation techniques to optimize the algorithm's hyperparameters. Inference involves encoding high-cardinality discrete features using this optimized algorithm and integrating them into existing machine learning models.
pse.effect: The proposed method reduces memory consumption, decreases the dimensionality of feature vectors, and achieves better generalization performance in federated learning scenarios compared to previous methods.
